name: chanjoongx-reflect
description: Notices when you keep pushing back on Claude Code, works out why, and tells the agent before its next step. Each of your messages is judged by Claude Haiku 5.5; when two land as pushback within six turns, Claude Opus 5.5 reads them and the agent receives a short note. A mod that calls models through your Claude Code session, so there is no API key to set.

reflection_model.title: Reflection model
reflection_model.description: Model that writes the reflection when pushback clusters. The judge on each message is always Claude Haiku 5.5. Both run through your Claude Code session and count toward its usage like its own requests.

max_usd_per_session.title: Spend cap per session (USD)
max_usd_per_session.description: reflect stops calling models in a session once its calls there have cost this much, priced at API rates.
